name: mockclock-monorepo
description: MockClock by Workfonic Labs: control time, test anything.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @workfonic/mockclock && npm run build --workspace @workfonic/mockclock-node && npm run build --workspace @workfonic/mockclock-cli && npm run build --workspace @workfonic/mockclock-playground
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @workfonic/mockclock && npm run build --workspace @workfonic/mockclock-node && npm run build --workspace @workfonic/mockclock-cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/node/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/playground/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
